{"script":"#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ws=/root/temp_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"

src=/root/matrix.txt
meta="$ws/matrix_meta.txt"
copy="$ws/matrix_copy.txt"
norm="$ws/matrix_normalized.txt"
preview="$ws/matrix_preview.txt"

if [ ! -r "$src" ]; then exit 2; fi

# record metadata
stat --format='Size:%s\nMode:%a\nUser:%U\nGroup:%G\nMtime:%y' "$src" > "$meta"
file -i "$src" >> "$meta" 2>/dev/null || true

orig_size=$(stat -c%s "$src")
echo "OriginalSize:$orig_size" >> "$meta"

# copy and verify size
cp "$src" "$copy"
copy_size=$(stat -c%s "$copy")
echo "CopySize:$copy_size" >> "$meta"
if [ "$orig_size" -eq "$copy_size" ]; then echo "CopySizeMatches:yes" >> "$meta"; else echo "CopySizeMatches:no" >> "$meta"; fi

# detect charset
charset=$(file -bi "$src" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*charset=\([^;]*\).*/\1/p' || true)
if [ -z "$charset" ]; then charset="unknown"; fi
echo "DetectedCharset:$charset" >> "$meta"

# normalize: convert to UTF-8 and LF line endings
if command -v iconv >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$charset" != "unknown" ]; then
  if iconv -f "$charset" -t utf-8//IGNORE "$copy" | sed 's/\r$//' > "$norm".tmp; then
    mv "$norm".tmp "$norm"
    echo "Normalized:iconv_from_$charset_to_utf-8" >> "$meta"
  else
    rm -f "$norm".tmp
    sed 's/\r$//' "$copy" > "$norm"
    echo "Normalized:sed_only (iconv failed)" >> "$meta"
  fi
else
  sed 's/\r$//' "$copy" > "$norm"
  echo "Normalized:sed_only (no iconv or unknown charset)" >> "$meta"
fi

norm_size=$(stat -c%s "$norm")
echo "NormalizedSize:$norm_size" >> "$meta"

# preview: first and last 10 lines
head -n 10 "$norm" > "$preview"
tail -n 10 "$norm" >> "$preview"
echo "PreviewLinesFirst:$(head -n 10 "$norm" | wc -l)" >> "$meta"
echo "PreviewLinesLast:$(tail -n 10 "$norm" | wc -l)" >> "$meta"

# verify preview matches corresponding parts
if cmp -s <(head -n 10 "$norm") <(head -n 10 "$preview"); then echo "PreviewHeadMatches:yes" >> "$meta"; else echo "PreviewHeadMatches:no" >> "$meta"; fi
if cmp -s <(tail -n 10 "$norm") <(tail -n 10 "$preview"); then echo "PreviewTailMatches:yes" >> "$meta"; else echo "PreviewTailMatches:no" >> "$meta"; fi

# verify artifacts exist
for f in "$copy" "$norm" "$preview" "$meta"; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "Exists:$(basename "$f"):yes" >> "$meta"; else echo "Exists:$(basename "$f"):no" >> "$meta"; fi
done

# record total original lines
orig_lines=$(wc -l < "$src" || true)
echo "OriginalLineCount:$orig_lines" >> "$meta"

# output only the number
printf "%s" "$orig_lines"
"}
